Both cells now read `card` against the app realm. The other 22 export-only keys stay: three of them match a bare token in the app and none reads the fusion, which is why a second realm is asked for an anchored read.
widenedNested: 2026-11-12 — `fusion.kernelAudit` is the third nested subtree judged, and the first read in more than one realm. `overdex-app.js` joins readerRealms with holder `fusion`, measured to move no depth-1 cell.
widenedElements: 2026-11-12 — depth 3. An element shape belongs to the BUILDER's element literal and not to the array key, so one `entry` shape serves `nodes[]` and `mismatches[]`. A member chain split across lines defeats a per-line regex: `overdex-app.js` writes the array on one line and `.map(` on the next, and a line-by-line scan reported that site as absent. The gate counts every element read it does not judge. 2026-11-13 — an element literal can sit AT the push site, and two push sites can disagree: `clockSkew.findings` unions 6 keys from the pairwise literal with 8 from the RTC-readback one, so `source` and `rtcVerifiedAtMs` are partial. A push is scoped by its ARRAY name and not by its function, because both pushes sit inside `.forEach` callbacks. The read census now also sees the INDEXED form, which raised the unjudged count from 1 to 2 by finding `vetoes[]` and `seamCensus[]`.
